method: Actual original random pulse arrays, live free/fixed boundary marker and real playback controls versus independent HTML reflection equations

controls.name: all four original randomly generated branches

results.scope: All four pulse branches obtained through fresh original reloads, without forcing random numbers or calling initialization functions. Full live 69-entry pulse array (including zero sentinel), original amplitude and actual boundary marker compared at default, start, pause and at least 30 naturally advancing fast-play phases per branch. Real fast/play/pause/resume controls checked. Fixed boundary stays at zero; free boundary marker follows the summed displacement. The fixed-end original clock is unset before the first play (raw blank retained); at that initial state only its pulse and fixed zero boundary are compared, and a finite advancing clock is required after play. Whole drawn spatial curves, every slow phase, separate-component switch, all initial seeds and pixel shapes remain outside scope. Native branch dropdown is a remaster addition.
